name: Notice
description: A quiet, persistent status line in a container: a small rounded box in a tone's colours, body-small text that wraps, an optional action and Dismiss at the end. The Ringmaster board's "Offline, reconnecting…" and "Your idea wasn't sent" lines.
usage: Use for a state the person should know about while it lasts, in place, under the header or above the content it is about: a lost connection, an action that didn't go through
Say it in one short line; it wraps on a phone. Keep it mounted and change its children when the state changes (Reconnecting… to the next message), so the change is announced through the same region
muted (default) for a passing state that needs nothing from the person; info, caution or error when it does. The tone is a colour, so the words carry the meaning too
An action only when the person can do something about it here (a small ghost Button, "Retry"); onDismiss when the line can be put away. Either makes it an alert
Width is the container's; className for layout
Not a toast (no timer, no stacking: use Toaster), not a dialog (use StatusCard or Modal), not an empty list (use EmptyState), not a banner across the page
examples:
// the board's quiet offline line: a polite status
<Notice>Offline, reconnecting…</Notice>

// with a glyph
<Notice tone="caution" icon={<WifiOff size={16} />}>Offline, reconnecting…</Notice>
design: Tones from the existing tokens, no new ones: muted is --color-text-muted on --color-surface-subtle; info, caution and error are --color-{tone}-fg on --color-{tone}-bg. Each passes 4.5:1 in Sage and Cobalt Mono, light and dark
A 1px border on every tone, because no tone's background reaches 3:1 against the page surfaces: muted --color-border-subtle; the others their fg mixed 30% into their bg
Corner --radius-md; padding --spacing-sm across and --spacing-2xs down; no shadow
Text type-body-sm (14px, line height 1.5) in the tone's fg, wrapping
The action and Dismiss (small ghost Buttons) at the end of the line when they fit beside 12rem of text, under the text, at the end, when not
The icon sits before the message, centred on the line, --spacing-2xs from it
accessibility: role="status" (polite, atomic) when it is only a message; role="alert" when it has an action or Dismiss, so the person hears there is something to do. A role passed in wins

Changing the children of a mounted Notice is announced through the same region. One that mounts with its text is announced unreliably by some screen readers: mount it empty or early when the first message matters
The icon is decorative and aria-hidden; the message carries the meaning
The action and Dismiss are real buttons in the Tab order; Dismiss's label is overridable (dismissLabel)

props.name: tone
props.description: The colours: muted text on the subtle surface, or a status tone's fg on its bg.

props.name: action
props.description: Something to do about it, at the end of the line: a small ghost levain Button. Makes the Notice an alert.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a small ghost Dismiss button that calls this. Makes the Notice an alert.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative glyph before the message, hidden from screen readers.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes merged with the box's own (cn); ref and other div props go to the root.
